name: Bọt Biển City #6 - The Architectural Masterpiece (1/1)
description:
The crown jewel and central architectural monument of Bọt Biển City Phase 2.

Rooted in physical reality, this artwork immortalizes an actual built architectural structure designed by the creator, re-imagined through surreal oceanic philosophy. As the pinnacle 1/1 Masterpiece of the collection, it serves as the living heart where the city's inhabitants converge.

[Master Collector Exclusive Privilege]
Acquiring this masterwork bestows the ultimate patron status:
1. Dedicated Presence: The collector is entitled to have 2 to 3 bespoke characters (self, loved ones, or companions) hand-drawn into the prime focal positions of the architecture (e.g., central grand terrace, main entrance, or panoramic balcony).
2. Sovereign Ownership: Sole, exclusive 1/1 ownership of the grand masterwork on the Base network.
3. Dynamic Legacy: As community residents from the Phase 1 custom passes are integrated, your figures remain immortalized as the central figures of the entire architectural narrative.

[Submission Terms & Guidelines]
- Civility: Submitted reference photos must remain respectful. No nudity, explicit, violent, defamatory, or hateful content.
- Non-Political: Strictly no political figures, party emblems, propaganda, or controversial geopolitical themes.
- Direct Collaboration: The architect will coordinate directly with the collector to curate positioning and harmony with the physical structure.

👉 [Click here to submit your master reference photos](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScEvZ1fjDDga49jtfnx2ThiSSE1qv3i2o7Cra4jJ-0VDutKSQ/viewform)
